reason: I'd ask Claude for the copy or the script first and only pay a person if that falls short. A 33 USDC all-in task with sealed entries and rubric setup is more process than I want for something small.
objection: The 10% fee plus the reward is more than I'd spend on a small task. It's paid in USDC on Solana, it hasn't been audited, and I'd have to approve a rubric and wait on a judge for something an AI draft would get me in minutes.
would_change_my_mind: A free first task that gave me a better result than my own AI draft, with a USDC-free payment option such as a card. I'd also want to see a few finished tasks like mine first.
